name: clean_tests_only
title: Tests for fmt_money
body: Adds unit tests for the money formatter. No code change.
diff:
### tests/test_money.py (added, +13/-0)
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+from billing.money import fmt_money
+
+
+def test_positive():
+    assert fmt_money(1234) == "USD 12.34"
+
+
+def test_negative():
+    assert fmt_money(-5) == "-USD 0.05"
+
+
+def test_currency():
+    assert fmt_money(100, "EUR") == "EUR 1.00"

files.billing/money.py:
def fmt_money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    sign = "-" if cents < 0 else ""
    cents = abs(cents)
    return f"{sign}{currency} {cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"
